narrator.role: Datin Sarah, BeliLah CEO. Calling from the airport, calm under pressure, no time to waste

segments.text: It's ten PM, the tenth of November. You're on call at BeliLah, Kuala Lumpur.
At midnight the eleven-eleven sale opens. Three million shoppers are waiting to check out.
This is Datin Sarah. I'm at the airport, and I'm told checkout is down. On the biggest night of our year.
I have three questions. Why are we down? Were we breached? And what is this costing us?
You have three Frontier Agents. Use them. You have eight minutes.
Thank you. That's the answer I can take to the board. The honest one.
Midnight. Eleven-eleven is live, and checkout is holding.
It's midnight, and I still don't have my answers.
The sale opened on a broken checkout. Come back and try again. The agents will be waiting.
